kit.why: Q4: the runtime lane's mail ack (+43), the engine lane's subagents and shared rises, less the chains checkpoint cut and the single guard hook builder, plus Node's real path for the guard hook under a Bun-compiled Pi; Q5: the built-in lead resolves through Pi OAuth logins only (+5), and SendMessage finds an agent a reopen left off the roster in the durable store (+10); bench: Monitor says an Agent or Workflow already notifies, and ListAgents tells a lead with running tasks to end its turn instead of polling (+3); bench: SendMessage to a workflow id names the session's workflows and says they take no messages (+3); bench: subagents retry a 429 or 5xx 5 times, about 62 s, and wf-null-on-failure counts the retries (+1); bench: in print and json mode, job_start without a timeout and Monitor say Pi exits when the turn ends and will not wait for them (+6); Q6 (+1): a built-in name such as astra or sol runs on a Pi OAuth login before an OPENAI_API_KEY alternative; a new Claude collaborator starts under a session id its resume names (+7); a stood-down collaborator keeps its last driver (+5); a Pi collaborator lists its peers before each mail delivery (+4); its guidance and persona ride on its launch instead of a before_agent_start that mail never fires (-2); a reply is owed only while mail is unread (-7); the guidance says mail arrives between turns (+1); Q8 (+34): collaborator_workspace list counts each worktree's uncommitted paths and commits ahead of its repo's HEAD, and cleanup refuses a worktree holding either, naming the paths, unless the lead passes discard: true, so a Codex writer's uncommitted work is no longer deleted silently; sleep (+18): bash refuses a command that starts with a foreground sleep of 60 s or more; exited (+1): a job or monitor command spawned as its session closes is killed at once; headless: print and json mode drop ask_user, collaborator_start and collaborator_workspace (+14); headless: a print or json mode lead applies the default it would propose instead of asking, and gets no silent-turn reminder (+5); subagents reuses shared isHeadless (-1); headless: a report that wakes a print or json mode lead repeats the headless rule, which Pi 1.0.4 drops from a report-started run after its first turn (+3); working rules (+18): the Pi lead (as Agent tool guidelines, so runs a task notification starts keep them) and Pi workers always read the kit's working rules, which yield to the user's and the project's own instructions; Pi workers get the precedence, scope, test and timeout rules; codemode: every Pi lead gets Pi's codemode tool unless defaultTools says -codemode or a --tools allowlist leaves it out (+2); codemode: Agent, job_start and ListAgents declare an outputSchema and return structuredContent, so scripts read ids and the roster as fields (+11); codemode: ask_user, collaborator_start and Workflow are model-only, so scripts cannot call them (+3); codemode: an Agent call from a script always launches in the background, since a script cannot wait and its nested call id never acks a foreground report (+5)

ext-codex-fast also covers the openai ChatGPT login, and the live smoke reads what agents ran on from their durable stores, since a lead on the openai login bypasses the request log; ext-chains drives a third turn to prove the 80% Chain reminder stops after one; Q5: the stall meter reads event-loop delay inside the lead from a polygon-only probe extension instead of a get_state round trip, which measured Pi 1.0.4's stdout backlog (+23); everything-at-once runs an 8-agent workflow under an active Mission that continues only after the last report, and its header says why it is still narrower (+8); model-lead-latest (+2) proves the default sol skips an openai API key and a set lead may use one; bench: Monitor says an Agent or Workflow already notifies, and ListAgents tells a lead with running tasks to end its turn instead of polling (+1);
